Shah Rukh Khan publicly affirmed that the release of his forthcoming film "King" will proceed as originally scheduled, dispelling rumours of any postponement.

He also disclosed that he suffered a few injuries while shooting the movie, but indicated that the injuries are not expected to impact the film’s release timetable.
